column2: [intro]
Morning, noon, and night, I scroll non-stop,
Instagram, Snapchat, I'm always on top,
A message, a notification, my joy is here,
I'm captivated, connected, my fingertips steer.
Always on my phone, I'm never alone,
Emojis and likes, make my eyes prone,
My phone, my friend, my virtual love,
I'm hooked, it’s clear, my eyes can't get enough.
Real friends, outings, leave me cold,
I prefer selfies and filters, that’s my mold,
I'm online all the time, addicted for sure,
My phone’s my kingdom, making life more pure.
My phone, my baby, it's glued to my hand,
I barely put it down, it's a force I can't withstand,
Whatsapp, Facebook, everyone’s in my grasp,
I'm hooked, it’s clear, I lose my reason fast.
[ solo ]
Always on my phone, I’m never alone,
Emojis and likes, make my eyes prone,
My phone, my friend, my virtual love,
I'm hooked, it’s clear, my eyes can’t get enough.
[outro]
